title: pageslens config
description: Configuration for `pageslens lint`: rule severities and ignored findings.

rules.description: Severity per rule id; `off` turns the rule off.

webapi-wildcard-fields.description: Web API is enabled on a table with `*` as the fields list. Default: error.

webapi-no-permission.description: Web API is enabled on a table that no table permission with a web role covers. Default: warning.

permission-no-role.description: A table permission has no web role, so it grants nothing. Default: warning.

global-write-anonymous.description: Global scope create, write or delete for the Anonymous Users role. Default: warning.

global-write-authenticated.description: Global scope create, write or delete for the Authenticated Users role. Default: warning.

parent-chain-broken.description: A parent-scope table permission whose parent is missing, has no web role, or loops back. Default: error.

scope-relationship-missing.description: A Contact, Account or Parent scope table permission without the relationship that scope needs. Default: error.

multiple-authenticated-roles.description: More than one web role is flagged as the Authenticated Users role. Default: error.

role-unused.description: A web role that no table permission, page access rule or website access uses (built-in roles are skipped). Default: info.

page-rule-no-page.description: A page access rule has no web page, or its page is missing or inactive, so it applies to nothing (info when it has no web role either). Default: warning.

page-rule-no-role.description: A page access rule has no web role: a Restrict Read hides its pages from everyone but Grant Change roles (error), a Grant Change does nothing (info). Default: error.

page-rule-anonymous.description: A page access rule lists the Anonymous Users role, which lets nobody in, anonymous visitors included. Default: error.

page-rules-conflict.description: A web page has more than one active Restrict Read rule. Default: error.

page-roles-not-subset.description: A Restrict Read rule lists a web role that a Restrict Read on a page above doesn't let in, so the role can't reach the page. Default: warning.

grant-change-overrides-read.description: A Grant Change rule lets a web role read pages that a Restrict Read on or below its page doesn't list. Default: warning.

page-rule-authenticated.description: A Restrict Read rule lists the Authenticated Users role with other roles, so every signed-in user passes it and the other roles add nothing. Default: warning.

page-parent-missing.description: A web page's parent page isn't in the site or is inactive (warning), or the parent pages loop, so who can read it is unknown. Default: error.

ignore.description: Findings to leave out. An entry matches a finding on any of its files or records, from the listed rules only when `rules` is given.

rules.description: Rule ids this entry applies to; every rule when left out.

files.description: Globs over the file paths lint prints, relative to the site folder: `*` within a folder, `**` across folders, `?` one character.

records.description: Record GUIDs, as lint prints them in JSON output (`recordId`).

reason.description: Why these findings are ignored, for reviewers.
